findings.title: Ledger-failure isolation test omits the reset_ai_credits assertion SPEC §9.1 enumerates
findings.spec_requirement: SPEC §9.1: existing branch behavior byte-identical around the insertions — 'the org update, payment-method call, reset_ai_credits still happen; a ledger failure does not break them'
findings.evidence: spec/jobs/stripe_webhook_handler_subscription_events_spec.rb:131-140 — the example where CreateSubscriptionEvent.call raises asserts the org period-end update and stripe_update_default_payment_method survive, but does not assert organization_ai_credit_balance reset_ai_credits. The success-path example (lines 121-128) asserts all three.
findings.recommendation: Add the reset_ai_credits assertion to the ledger-failure example, mirroring the success-path example's three-behavior coverage (~3 lines).

spec_coverage.notes: Agents 1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10 clean. Agent 8 delicacy audit: webhook diff is exactly two additive hunks (34 insertions / 0 deletions), every line classified as sanctioned. Agent 10 reverse traceability: all 11 diff files, every hunk traced to a SPEC section; §10 out-of-scope sweep clean.
